intro.en: Answers to common questions about this site.

question.en: What does WIP mean on an agent card?

answer.en: The build for that agent has not been written yet. The card is shown but cannot be opened until a build exists.

question.en: What are the S1 to S5 buttons on W-Engines?

answer.en: They switch the W-Engine passive between its five superimposition levels.
It lists the agents whose best build recommends that Drive Disc set as a 4-piece set. Hover an agent to see their recommended main stats and substats.
